title: Creo workflows and connector status
description: Explore Creo workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Creo

PTC Creo supports parametric product design, assemblies and model-based engineering workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Drive a part with parameters

Begin with current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended Creo preview, drive a part with parameters; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Evaluate an assembly variant

Use the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended Creo preview, evaluate an assembly variant; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Publish model-based definition

Start from the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended Creo preview, publish model-based definition; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
